verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for an AI-driven accounting platform, but the pack documents no user-configurable recurring schedule. The closest items describe automation ('described once, done automatically'), month-end AI Close agents, custom categorization rules, and running a forecast as a one-off AI task. None of these documents a time-based recurring job or workflow the user can schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
